abort.single_instance_allowed: Food Planning is already set up.

user.description: Recipes are extracted by an AI task entity, for example one from the Anthropic integration.

data.sort_shopping: Sort the shopping list by store section

data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty to use the preferred AI task entity from Settings > System > General.
data_description.language: Imported recipes are written in this language, e.g. Swedish.
data_description.merge_shopping: When items are added, the AI merges duplicates, e.g. "2 msk olivolja" and "15 ml olivolja" into "3 msk olivolja".
data_description.sort_shopping: Items are ordered the way a typical grocery store is walked, fruit and vegetables first and frozen food last. The section is worked out along with the product name, so it needs no extra AI calls. Turn off to order the list yourself.
data_description.update_pantry: When a recipe is marked as cooked, the AI subtracts what it used from the At home list.
data_description.admin_only: When on, only administrator users can edit or delete recipes. Everyone can still import, shop and cook.

data.sort_shopping: Sort the shopping list by store section

data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty to use the preferred AI task entity from Settings > System > General.
data_description.language: Imported recipes are written in this language, e.g. Swedish.
data_description.merge_shopping: When items are added, the AI merges duplicates, e.g. "2 msk olivolja" and "15 ml olivolja" into "3 msk olivolja".
data_description.sort_shopping: Items are ordered the way a typical grocery store is walked, fruit and vegetables first and frozen food last. The section is worked out along with the product name, so it needs no extra AI calls. Turn off to order the list yourself.
data_description.update_pantry: When a recipe is marked as cooked, the AI subtracts what it used from the At home list.
data_description.categories: One per line. The AI picks from these when importing. Removing one takes it off its recipes.
data_description.admin_only: When on, only administrator users can edit or delete recipes. Everyone can still import, shop and cook.

weekly.name: Weekly dinners
weekly.description: A loose pool of dinner ideas from your saved recipes. Nothing is scheduled to a day; pinned and added dinners are never replaced.

data_description.weekly_dinners: A few dinner ideas from your own recipes each week, in the recipe view.
data_description.weekly_day: When the new week's suggestions are made. Monday morning is when most stores' new flyers are out.
data_description.weekly_new_ideas: The AI may suggest one dish that isn't among your recipes.

offers_section.name: Offers
offers_section.description: Offers come from the stores' weekly flyers, around your home location.

data_description.offers: Marks ingredients and shopping items that are on offer at stores you pick. Uses an unofficial flyer API that may stop working.
data_description.offers_radius: How far from home to look for stores.
data_description.offers_min_discount: Offers with a stated discount of at least this much are highlighted and favoured in the weekly dinners.
data_description.offers_stores: Grocery stores within the radius, nearest first. ICA, Willys, Hemköp and Coop have a flyer per store. If you change the radius, the list is shown again when you save.

error.cannot_fetch_stores: Could not fetch stores from the flyer API. Try again later; your selected stores are kept.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Extracts a recipe from a link or pasted text and saves it to the recipe list. A link that was imported before returns the saved recipe.

url.name: Link
url.description: Recipe page or TikTok video. TikTok recipes are read from the video's caption.

text.name: Text
text.description: Recipe text to extract from instead of a link.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Also add the ingredients to the shopping list.

add_recipe_to_shopping_list.name: Add recipe to shopping list
add_recipe_to_shopping_list.description: Adds a saved recipe's ingredients to the shopping list, skipping ones already on it.

only_missing.name: Only missing
only_missing.description: Only add the ingredients that aren't at home.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Only add these of the recipe's ingredients (exact text).

move_bought_to_pantry.name: Move bought items home
move_bought_to_pantry.description: Moves ticked-off items from the shopping list to the At home list. Duplicates are then merged by the AI.

start_timer.name: Start cooking timer
start_timer.description: Starts a cooking timer. It shows on the Food Planning dashboards, and the Cooking timer event fires when it finishes.

label.name: Label
label.description: What the timer is for, e.g. "Boil the pasta".

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Recipe title or ID the timer belongs to.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Timer ID or label. Leave empty for all timers.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Timer ID or label. Leave empty for all timers.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel cooking timer
cancel_timer.description: Stops and removes cooking timers, or dismisses finished ones.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Timer ID or label. Leave empty for all timers.

extend_timer.name: Add time to cooking timer
extend_timer.description: Adds time to cooking timers. A finished timer starts again.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Timer ID or label. Leave empty for all timers.

mark_cooked.name: Mark recipe as cooked
mark_cooked.description: Remembers that a recipe was cooked, ticks it off the weekly dinners and updates At home.

plan_week.name: Plan weekly dinners
plan_week.description: Makes the week's dinner suggestions again. Pinned and added dinners are kept.

count.name: Number of dinners
count.description: Defaults to the number in the settings.

get_weekly_dinners.name: Get weekly dinners
get_weekly_dinners.description: Returns the week's dinners with reasons, missing ingredients and offers.

add_to_week.name: Add to weekly dinners
add_to_week.description: Adds a recipe to the week's dinners. It stays until cooked.

remove_from_week.name: Remove from weekly dinners
remove_from_week.description: Removes a dinner; it isn't suggested again this week.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Recipe title or ID, or an idea's title.

add_week_to_shopping_list.name: Shop for the week
add_week_to_shopping_list.description: Adds what's missing for the week's dinners not cooked yet to the shopping list.

get_offers.name: Get offers
get_offers.description: Returns a selected store's current offers, biggest discount first.

store.name: Store
store.description: Store ID or (part of) its name.

search_offers.name: Search offers
search_offers.description: Searches the selected stores' current offers.

stores.name: Stores
stores.description: Only these stores (ID or name). Leave empty for all.

min_discount.name: Smallest discount
min_discount.description: Only offers with at least this stated discount.

not_loaded.message: Food Planning is not set up or not loaded.

missing_input.message: Paste a recipe link or text first.

site_refused.message: {url} blocks automated access. Open the recipe, copy its text and import it as text instead.

tiktok_no_caption.message: The TikTok video has no caption to read a recipe from.

no_recipe_found.message: No recipe was found in the content.

ai_task_missing.message: No AI task integration is available. Set up one, for example Anthropic, first.

ai_task_bad_response.message: The AI task returned an unexpected response.

weekly_off.message: Weekly dinners are turned off in the settings.

offers_off.message: Offers are turned off, or no stores are selected.
